metadata.description: Generic Claude Code plugins for AI engineering workflows. Sole plugin since v4.0.0: learn-kit — pedagogical kit covering manual 8-stage authoring methodology, AI three-tier learning doc generation with interactive HTML, and NotebookLM multimedia artifact generation (audio/video/slide_deck/mind_map/infographic × 3 view variants). Tested with mj-system and mj-agent.

plugins.name: learn-kit
plugins.description: Pedagogical kit for learnable knowledge artifacts. Five skills: (1) /learn-kit:init scaffolds the learning subsystem; (2) /learn-kit:locate reverse-looks up concepts; (3) /learn-kit:scan enumerates learnable docs; (4) /learn-kit:generate-tier AI-generates three-tier (foundation/structural/challenge) learning markdown plus optional interactive HTML; (5) /learn-kit:nlm-studio pushes a topic's three-tier corpus to NotebookLM and generates up to 15 online-viewable multimedia artifacts. nlm-studio requires notebooklm-mcp MCP server (bundled) + nlm login; the other four skills run with no external dependencies.
